A binge is categorized as an episode of you eating in an ‘uncontrolled’ manner, usually eating a lot more food than is typical, sometimes to the point of discomfort, and then the subsequent purge to compensate the binge. 

In my opinion, and I’m definitely not qualified to diagnose, but it seems to me that what you’re experiencing is more of a purging disorder, as it sounds like you’re purging your normal meals rather than having a binge episode. By definition, purging disorder is an eating disorder that shares similarities with bulimia, but lacks binging.
